title: Planning documents automation tool
summary: Tool that generates planning documents automatically from a planning software's exports, for a road-construction company.
highlights: Designed a tool that generates weekly planning documents, site organisation notes and a long-term tonnage plan from exports of the client's planning software, replacing manual re-entry.
Chose Excel with Power Query, macros and SharePoint, tools the client already uses, so that the client can maintain the solution without a new licence or server.
Added automatic consistency checks on dates and tonnages, with missing information entered only once.
Planned a user guide, technical documentation and a training session so that the client can maintain the tool in-house.
learned: Requirements analysis on messy real-world data.
Automating a reporting chain end to end and documenting it for non-developers.
